title: [IMP2-5] Community-channel key access rules contradict each other
description: Review finding IMP2-5: Community-channel key access rules contradict each other (lens IMP2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:311; spec/05-messaging.md:49, :132. Fix: 03:311 serves keys by role, while 05:49 and 05:132 serve them "only to members of the speaker group". The endpoint has no defined way to learn the speaker group. The broadcast decision memo ("non-speakers can't read") is met either way, because MLS protects the content. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
